animations.name: Little Chuckle
animations.description: A gentle blink and a little chuckle. An easygoing companion for a quieter corner.

animations.name: Midnight Octopus
animations.description: A mellow neon octopus rolls a joint, takes a puff, and sends a smoke ring drifting past its curling arms.

animations.name: Bone Rattle
animations.description: A neon-stage skeleton drummer with swinging sticks, a bouncing jaw, glowing eyes, and a double cymbal crash.

animations.name: Blown Orange
animations.description: A 1970 Dodge Challenger with a huge chrome supercharger, spinning pulleys, expressive eyes, and exhaust-flame bursts.

animations.name: Trash Titan
animations.description: A monster garbage truck with giant tires, chomping teeth, a trash-can snatching tongue, bouncing garbage, and green exhaust.

animations.name: Screen Ripper
animations.description: Four hooked claws tear open the display, revealing a giant cyclops that lunges through the glowing split.

animations.name: Blue Thunder
animations.description: A cheerful blue Dodge-inspired monster truck jumps over three toy cars, spins its wheels, and lands with a happy suspension bounce.

animations.name: Dino Dozer
animations.description: A friendly T. rex drives a little loader, scoops colorful blocks, and accidentally builds a wobbly tower on its hard hat.

animations.name: Mopar or No Car
animations.description: A Plum Crazy purple 1970 Dodge Charger lights up its rear tire with spinning chrome, rolling smoke, and a huge supercharger.

animations.name: Richardson Motors
animations.description: A red Dodge and silver Ram under sweeping showroom lights, with Richardson Motors lettering and Cuba City, WI beneath.

animations.name: Car Wash Chaos
animations.description: A detailed orange truck with spinning wash brushes, sweeping wipers, water spray, falling foam, and a sparkling clean reveal.

animations.name: Cosmic Grease Monkey
animations.description: A detailed alien mechanic with articulated arms, a ratcheting wrench, pumping pistons, rotating pulleys, and an engine that lifts off its stand.

animations.name: Supercharged Dodge
animations.description: A red Dodge-inspired muscle car shakes its giant blower, spins the pulleys, and launches a fiery rev through a smoky neon garage.

animations.name: Dragon Behind the Glass
animations.description: A richly illustrated dragon with hinged wings, a moving jaw, a fiery sneeze, and a claw that wipes soot off the glass.

animations.name: Shark Glass Inspector
animations.description: A richly shaded reef shark with a gentle tail sweep, fin strokes, a relaxed blink, and a friendly grin against the glass.

animations.name: Orbital Cleanup
animations.description: A cheerful space robot grabs floating junk, crushes it into a cube, and sends itself scooting backward with an overenthusiastic launch.

animations.name: Phantom Garage
animations.description: Two glowing ghost mechanics assemble a purple Dodge-inspired hot rod from floating parts, then send it rumbling into a cloud of purple smoke.

animations.name: Raccoon Pit Crew
animations.description: A richly illustrated raccoon mechanic works a ratcheting wrench and pumping jack while a runaway tire rolls through the garage.

animations.name: Shop Dog
animations.description: A Mopar shop bulldog beside a chrome V8. Blower plates open with the rev while the belt and pulleys turn and the bulldog blinks.
